rows.headline: ONGC negotiates to take over Venezuelan oilfields to recover dues
rows.hook: Recovering $500 million trapped in Venezuela
rows.summary: State-owned ONGC Videsh is in advanced talks with Venezuelan and U.S. authorities to take over operations at two oil projects within six months. The takeover aims to help the company recover more than $500 million in unpaid dividends. ONGC currently holds investments in the San Cristobal field, among others. Indian retail investors tracking energy stocks should watch this cross-border asset recovery effort.
rows.whats_next: Agreements expected to be finalized in 3 to 6 months
rows.why_it_matters: Unlocks $500 million in stuck foreign dividends for ONGC.
rows.winners_losers: ONGC gains / Venezuela operations unblocked
